title: Gyara dabara

errors.nesting: Wannan dabarar tana da matakan da suka yi yawa sosai.
errors.brackets: Bakutocin jeri ba su dace ba.
errors.method: Dole ne sifa ko aiki ya zo na gaba.
errors.pageMethod: Dole ne sifa ko aiki ya zo na gaba.
errors.invalid: Ba a iya karanta dabarar ba.
errors.unknownProperty: Babu wata sifa da ake kira {{name}}.
errors.nonBlockProperty: Ana iya karanta sifofi daga shafi ne kawai.
errors.typeOperation: Ba a iya yin lissafi tsakanin ƙimar {{left}} da {{right}}.
errors.typeComparison: Ba za a iya kwatanta ƙimar {{left}} da {{right}} ba.
errors.typeArgument: {{name}}() ba ya karɓar ƙimar {{type}} a nan.
errors.typeUnary: Ba za a iya saka alamar ragi a kan ƙimar {{type}} ba.
errors.typeCalled: Ba za a iya kira ƙimar {{type}} ba.
errors.resultType: Dabara ba za ta iya mayar da {{type}} ba. Za ta iya mayar da {{name}} ko undefined.
errors.unclosedString: Zaren rubutu da ba a rufe ba.
errors.invalidCharacter: Dabara ba za ta iya ɗaukar “{{token}}” ba.
errors.unknownMethod: Ba za a iya samun aikin {{name}}() ba.
errors.argumentsMissing: {{name}}() ba shi da isassun hujjoji: yana bukatar {{expected}} amma yana da {{given}}.
errors.callFailed: Ba a iya gudanar da {{name}}() ba.
errors.roundNonInteger: Kewayawa na bukatar cikakken adadin wuraren decimal, ba {{precision}} ba.
errors.roundTooManyPlaces: Kewayawa yana tsayawa a wuraren decimal 12, don haka {{precision}} ba zai yi aiki ba.
errors.toNumberList: Ba za a iya saka jeri a cikin toNumber() ba; yi amfani da first() ko at() don abu ɗaya, ko map() don kowanne.
errors.durationUnit: “{{unit}}” ba wani rukunin lokaci ba ne da {{name}}() ya san.
errors.unsafePattern: Furcin ka'ida ba zai iya maimaita rukuni da ya riga ya maimaita ba, kamar (a+)+.
errors.libraryCall: Ba a iya gudanar da {{name}}() ba.

operators.remainder: Abin da ya rage bayan an raba lambar hagu da ta dama.
operators.power: Lambar hagu da aka ɗaga zuwa ƙarfin lambar dama.
operators.greater: Ko ƙimar hagu ta fi ta dama girma.
operators.greaterOrEqual: Ko ƙimar hagu ta yi daidai da ta dama ko ta fi ta.
operators.less: Ko ƙimar hagu ta fi ta dama ƙanƙanta.
operators.lessOrEqual: Ko ƙimar hagu ba ta wuce ta dama ba.
operators.condition: Ƙimar ta biyu idan sharadi ya tabbata, in ba haka ba ƙimar ta uku.
operators.not: Yana juya true zuwa false da false zuwa true.

functions.if: Yana duba yanayi: true yana ba da ƙima ta farko, false kuma ta biyu.
functions.ifs: Yana duba yanayi bi da bi sannan ya ba da ƙimar da ta dace da na farko da ya zama true. Wata gajeriyar hanyar rubuta if() cikin if().
functions.let: Yana ba wa ƙima suna, sannan yana lissafta furci ta amfani da wannan sunan.
functions.lets: Yana ba wa ƙimomi da yawa suna, sannan yana lissafta furci ta amfani da waɗannan sunayen.
functions.not: Yana juya true zuwa false, false kuma zuwa true.
functions.empty: Ko ƙimar fanko ce: 0, “”, false, [] da kuma abubuwan da ba su da komai duk ana ɗaukarsu a matsayin fanko. Idan babu komai a cikin baka, yana ba da ƙima marar komai.
functions.length: Yawan haruffan da rubutu ke da su, ko yawan abubuwan da jeri ke da su.
functions.format: An rubuta ƙimar a matsayin rubutu.
functions.substring: Wani ɓangare na rubutun, daga startIndex har zuwa kafin endIndex; idan babu endIndex, har zuwa ƙarshe.
functions.contains: Ko rubutun da ake nema ya bayyana a cikin ƙimar.
functions.startsWith: Ko rubutu ya fara da wani.
functions.endsWith: Ko rubutu ya ƙare da wani.
functions.test: Ko rubutun ya yi daidai da tsari, wato regular expression.
functions.match: Jerin duk sassan rubutun da suka yi daidai da tsari, wato regular expression.
functions.replace: Yana maye gurbin ɓangare na farko da ya yi daidai da tsari da abin maye gurbi.
functions.replaceAll: Yana maye gurbin kowane ɓangare da ya yi daidai da tsari da abin maye gurbi.
functions.trim: Rubutun da aka yanke sarari daga farkonsa da ƙarshensa.
functions.repeat: Rubutun da aka maimaita sau count, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
functions.padStart: Yana ƙara padString a gaban rubutun har sai ya kai tsawon targetLength.
functions.padEnd: Yana ƙara padString a bayan rubutun har sai ya kai tsawon targetLength.
functions.link: Mahaɗi da ke nuna rubutun kuma yana buɗe url idan an danna shi.
functions.style: Yana yi wa rubutu tsari. Tsare-tsare: “b” mai ƙarfi, “i” karkatacce, “u” layi a ƙasa, “s” yankakken layi, “c” lambar code. Launuka: “gray”, “brown”, “orange”, “yellow”, “green”, “blue”, “purple”, “pink”, “red”; ƙara “_background” bayan launi don samun launin baya maimakon.
functions.unstyle: Yana cire tsari daga rubutu: tsare-tsaren da aka ambata, ko duka idan ba a ambaci ɗaya ba.
functions.split: Yana yanke rubutu a kowane mai rabewa sannan yana ba da sassan a matsayin jeri.
functions.join: Yana haɗa abubuwan jeri zuwa rubutu ɗaya, tare da joiner a tsakaninsu.
functions.formatNumber:
An rubuta lambar a matsayin rubutu.

format ɗin shine “commas” (na asali), “percent”, “humanize”, “bytes_binary”, “bytes_decimal” ko ɗaya daga cikin lambobin kuɗi da ke ƙasa.

precision yana ƙayyade yawan lambobin da ke bayan alamar goma, daga 0 zuwa 12.

Lambobin kuɗi: “usd”, “aud”, “cad”, “sgd”, “eur”, “gbp”, “jpy”, “rub”, “inr”, “krw”, “cny”, “brl”, “try”, “idr”, “chf”, “hkd”, “nzd”, “sek”, “nok”, “mxn”, “zar”, “twd”, “dkk”, “pln”, “thb”, “huf”, “czk”, “ils”, “clp”, “php”, “aed”, “cop”, “sar”, “myr”, “ron”, “ars”, “uyu”, “pen”, “vnd”, “pkr”, “ngn”.
functions.toNumber: Yana mai da rubutu, ko wata ƙima, zuwa lamba.
functions.add: Lambobin biyu da aka haɗa tare.
functions.subtract: Lambar ta biyu da aka cire daga ta farko.
functions.divide: Lambar farko da aka raba da ta biyu.
functions.mod: Abin da ya rage bayan an raba lambar farko da ta biyu.
functions.pow: Lambar farko da aka ɗaga zuwa ikon lambar ta biyu.
functions.min: Mafi ƙanƙanta a cikin lambobin da aka bayar.
functions.max: Mafi girma a cikin lambobin da aka bayar.
functions.sum: Jimillar dukkan lambobin da aka bayar.
functions.median: Lambar tsakiya a cikin lambobin da aka bayar, bayan an jera su.
functions.abs: Lambar ba tare da alamarta ba: lambar marar kyau ta zama tabbatacciya.
functions.round: Lambar da aka zagaye zuwa mafi kusancin cikakkiyar lamba.
functions.ceil: Lambar da aka zagaye sama zuwa cikakkiyar lamba.
functions.floor: Lambar da aka zagaye ƙasa zuwa cikakkiyar lamba.
functions.sqrt: Tushen murabba'i na lambar, wanda tabbatacce ne.
functions.exp: e (kusan 2.718, tushen logariti na halitta) zuwa ikon lambar.
functions.ln: Logariti na halitta na lambar, a tushen e.
functions.sign: 1 ga lambar tabbatacciya, -1 ga marar kyau, 0 ga sifili.
functions.pi: π, kewayen da'irar a kan diamita (kusan 3.14159).
functions.today: Kwanan watan yau, ba tare da lokaci ba.
functions.parseDate: Yana karanta kwanan wata da aka rubuta a tsarin ISO 8601, kamar 2022-01-01.
functions.nextWorkday: Kwanan watan idan ranar aiki ce, in ba haka ba sai na gaba: ba ranar karshen mako ko hutun jama'a ba (na Koriya, ko lambar kalanda).
functions.addWorkdays: Kwanan wata da aka matsar da adadin ranakun aiki, ana tsallake karshen mako da hutun jama'a (na Koriya, ko lambar kalanda).
functions.formatDate: Yana rubuta kwanan wata a matsayin rubutu a tsarin da aka bayar, kuma a wani yankin lokaci idan an ambata ɗaya. A cikin tsarin, “YYYY” shekara ce, “MM” wata ne, “DD” rana ce, “HH” awa ce, “mm” minti ne.
functions.dateAdd: Kwanan wata da aka ƙara num raka'a. unit ɗaya ne daga cikin “years”, “quarters”, “months”, “weeks”, “days”, “hours” da “minutes”.
functions.dateSubtract: Kwanan wata da aka cire num raka'a. unit ɗaya ne daga cikin “years”, “quarters”, “months”, “weeks”, “days”, “hours” da “minutes”.
functions.dateBetween: Kwanan wata na farko ya rage na biyu, ana ƙidaya da unit: ɗaya daga cikin “years”, “quarters”, “months”, “weeks”, “days”, “hours” da “minutes”.
functions.dateRange: Kewayon kwanan wata daga kwanan watan farko zuwa kwanan watan ƙarshe.
functions.dateStart: Kwanan watan farko na kewayon kwanan wata.
functions.dateEnd: Kwanan wata na ƙarshe a cikin kewayon kwanakin.
functions.timestamp: Kwanan wata a matsayin tambarin lokacin Unix: adadin millisekan da suka wuce tun daga 1 ga Janairu, 1970.
functions.fromTimestamp: Kwanan watan da tambarin lokacin Unix ke wakilta (millisekan da suka wuce tun daga 1 ga Janairu, 1970), ba tare da daƙiƙansa da millisekansa ba.
functions.week: Makon ISO na shekarar kwanan wata, daga 1 zuwa 53.
functions.date: Ranar kwanan wata a cikin wata, daga 1 zuwa 31.
functions.day: Ranar mako ta kwanan wata a matsayin lamba, daga 1 na Litinin zuwa 7 na Lahadi.
functions.at: Abin da ke cikin jeri a matsayin index, ana kirga daga 0.
functions.slice: Sashe na jeri, daga startIndex har zuwa kafin endIndex; idan babu endIndex, har zuwa ƙarshe.
functions.concat: Jerukan da aka haɗa bi-da-bi suka zama jeri ɗaya.
functions.sort: Jerin da aka tsara. Ba da furci don zaɓar abin da ake tsara kowane abu da shi.
functions.reverse: Yana mayar da jeri a juyi.
functions.unique: Jerin ba tare da ƙimar da ta maimaita ba.
functions.includes: Ko jeri yana ɗauke da ƙimar da ake nema.
functions.find: Abin farko a cikin jeri da ya cika sharadi.
functions.findIndex: Matsayin da abin farko da ya cika sharadi yake a cikin jeri, ana kirga daga 0.
functions.filter: Abubuwan da ke cikin jeri da suka cika sharadi kawai.
functions.some: Ko aƙalla abu ɗaya a cikin jeri ya cika sharadi.
functions.every: Ko kowane abu a cikin jeri ya cika sharadi.
functions.map: Sabon jeri da aka yi ta hanyar lissafta furci ga kowane abu.
functions.flat: Yana fitar da abubuwa daga cikin jerirai masu ɗaɗi ya sanya su cikin jeri ɗaya.
functions.name: Sunan mutum.
functions.id: ID na shafi ko mutum. Idan an bar shi fanko, shi ne ID na shafin da wannan dabarar take a kai.
functions.splice: Yana fitar da abubuwa deleteCount daga jeri a startIndex, sannan ya saka duk wasu ƙimomi a wurinsu. Idan babu deleteCount, ba a fitar da kome ba.
functions.count: Adadin abubuwan da ke cikin jeri da suka cika sharadi. Idan babu sharadi, ana kirga kowane abu, kamar yadda length() ke yi.

emptyValueCall: Ana iya ba wa wannan kira ƙima marar komai.
unknownTargetCall: Ana amfani da {{name}}() akan ƙima wadda wataƙila ba ta nau'in {{type}} ba.
unknownArgumentCall: Ana ba wa {{name}}() ƙima wadda wataƙila ba ta nau'in {{type}} ba.
